text.value: The submission claims a full proof that, for every N >= 1, the maximum size of a set A subset of {1, ..., N} such that ab + 1 is nonsquarefree for every a, b in A is floor((N + 18)/25).

locator.quote: For every N >= 1, let A subset [1,N] satisfy the condition that ab+1 is nonsquarefree for every a,b in A, with a=b allowed. We determine the exact maximum cardinality of such a set, proving |A| <= floor((N+18)/25).

scope.value: The record concerns the paper and the v1.0.5-kernel Lean formalization release, not a conclusion that the mathematical claim is established.

open_invitations.target: Reproduce the pinned Lean release and report the build and certificate result within the published-cache replay trust boundary.
open_invitations.how: Check out tag v1.0.5-kernel at commit bb8e1b10b0066639ee3440ba983c3f9774667d42. Download all 75 cache-shard ZIP files together with the manifest and checksum assets, place them in one directory, and run python -B scripts/install_release_cache.py --asset-dir <download-directory> --prepare-dependencies --kernel --memory-mib 32768. Do not run lake update. Record the toolchain, commands, result, resource limits, and log hash. This checks reproducibility, not the truth of the mathematical claim.
